This synthetic DEX was generated locally using JDK 17 (`-source 8 -target 8`)
and Android build-tools 37.0.0 D8 (`--min-api 29`). It contains no case material.
`RecoveryFixture.add(int,int)` returns the sum. Its lab-only main maps a supplied
file read-only, prints its first byte and sleeps for four minutes. Tests parse
the bytes; they never launch it on a device. SHA-256 of decoded bytes:
`026ff78d9ef218aecf48ae868d37efd733923eeae2b634efb63b92a32324fda7`.
